title: 第25章 青翼王蛇渡劫第26章 自爆
content_zh:
张皓旸眼睛有些湿润，脸上有泪水滑落，他满怀感激的摸了一下小白的小脑袋，下定决心今后一定要好好的保护小白，要好好的照顾它，不让它再受到任何伤害！
张皓旸看着小白，从空间戒指内拿出几颗当初小白带着他找到的疗伤果实放到小白身边，对它说：“这些都是你带着我找到的果实，这颗是青灵果、这颗是万灵仙芝果、这颗是百年红心果，它们对你的伤势都有妙用，你先吃了它们吧！”
小白听到张皓旸竟能叫出几种果实的名称，眼中难掩喜悦崇拜之情，口中轻声“嗷嗷”
两声，似是在夸赞张皓旸的博学多识。
小白按照张皓旸的要求将青灵果、万灵仙芝果和百年红心果吃下，大约过去一个时辰后，小白的伤势就基本恢复如初。
张皓旸与小白一人一兽就坐在一棵大树下，好似一对好友一般聊起来。
张皓旸将它这几天的经历对小白讲了一番，他虽不知道他讲的
话小白能听懂多少？但是他知道，小白不会怪他将这些话讲给它听！
不会嫌他啰嗦麻烦！
每每说到关键、精彩之处，小白就“嗷嗷”
叫上两声，似是在惊诧又是在附和。
就这样一人一兽见面好似有说不完的话！
就在此时，天空突然传来一道“轰隆”
雷声，紧接着就是电闪雷鸣，狂风暴雨，那雷声中还夹杂着好似龙吟之声。
张皓旸与小白被这突如其来的电闪雷鸣吓了一跳，他们立即抬头循声望去，只见空中有一条身长百丈、头长两角、背负双翅的的青翼
蛇在云中穿梭。
这条青翼蛇明显要比普通的青翼蛇大上数倍不止，头部两角为赤红色。
按照他记忆中异物志中的记载描述可知此蛇应该为青翼蛇族中的王者也就是青翼王蛇，青翼王蛇是一种最接近龙族一脉的龙属性妖兽。
只见青翼王蛇在云层之间，在电闪雷鸣之下不断摆动身躯，不停发出咆哮的龙吟，青翼王蛇巨大身体的七寸之处有光芒闪烁。
所有的雷电都集中在青翼王蛇所在的区域，其他区域则是没有一丝雷电。

很明显，这条青翼王蛇在渡化形劫。
妖兽的修为层次划分为聚灵境、通智境、妖丹境、凝魄境、合道境、化形境、神游境，分别对应人类修者的炼体境、筑基境、结丹境、元婴境、至尊境、化神境、天元境，天元境以上就是修仙者的存在，天元境之下统称为修真者。
妖兽的化形境对应人类的化神境，妖兽化形境顾名思义就是化为人形，妖兽一旦渡劫成功就可直接化为人形，看上去与人类修士无异。
看此情景这条青翼王蛇应该就是在渡化形劫。
content_en:
Zhang Haoyang's eyes were a little moist, and tears fell down his face. He touched Xiaobai's little head gratefully, and made up his mind to protect Xiaobai from now on, take good care of it, and prevent it from getting hurt again!
Zhang Haoyang looked at Xiaobai, took out a few healing fruits that Xiaobai had found with him from the space ring, put them next to Xiaobai, and said to him: "These are the fruits you brought me to find. This one is the Green Spirit Fruit, this one is the Wanling Immortal Zhizhi Fruit, and this one is the Centennial Red Heart Fruit. They all have wonderful effects on your injuries, so you eat them first!"
When Xiaobai heard that Zhang Haoyang could actually call out the names of several fruits, he couldn't hide the joy and admiration in his eyes, and softly said "Ouch" in his mouth.
The two sounds seemed to be praising Zhang Haoyang for his erudition and knowledge.
Xiaobai ate the Qingling Fruit, the All-Lingxian Zhizhi Fruit and the Centennial Red Heart Fruit as requested by Zhang Haoyang. After about an hour, Xiaobai's injuries basically recovered as before.
Zhang Haoyang and Xiaobai were sitting under a big tree, chatting like a pair of good friends.
Zhang Haoyang told Xiaobai his experiences in the past few days. Although he didn't know what he was talking about,
How much can a novice understand? But he knew that Xiaobai would not blame him for telling it these words!
I won’t find it troublesome for him to be verbose!
Whenever the key and exciting points are mentioned, Xiaobai will "ouch"
He yelled twice, seemingly in surprise and agreement.
When one person and one animal meet like this, there seems to be endless things to say!
At this moment, a "bang" suddenly came from the sky
Thunder, followed by lightning, thunder, violent storms, and the thunder was also mixed with a sound like a dragon's roar.
Zhang Haoyang and Xiaobai were startled by the sudden thunder and lightning. They immediately raised their heads and looked around. They saw a green wing that was a hundred feet long, with two horns on its head and two wings on its back.
Snakes slither through the clouds.
This green-winged snake is obviously several times larger than the ordinary green-winged snake, and the two corners of its head are red.
According to the records and descriptions in the Foreign Object Chronicles in his memory, it can be seen that this snake should be the king of the Green Winged Snake clan, that is, the Green Winged King Snake. The Green Winged King Snake is a dragon-attribute monster closest to the dragon clan.
I saw the Green-winged King Snake between the clouds, constantly swinging its body under the lightning and thunder, and kept making roaring dragon roars. Seven inches of the Green-winged King Snake's huge body shone with light.
All the thunder and lightning were concentrated in the area where the Green Winged King Snake was, and there was no trace of thunder and lightning in other areas.
It is obvious that this green-winged king snake is going through the catastrophe of transformation.
The cultivation levels of monster beasts are divided into the spirit-gathering realm, the wisdom realm, the demon elixir realm, the soul-condensing realm, the combination realm, the form-transformation realm, and the divine wandering realm, which correspond to the body-refining realm, the foundation-building realm, the elixir-forming realm, the Yuanying realm, the supreme realm, the spirit-transformation realm, and the Tianyuan realm of human cultivators respectively. Above the Tianyuan realm are the existence of immortal cultivators, and below the Tianyuan realm are collectively called cultivators.
The realm of transformation of monsters corresponds to the realm of human beings. As the name suggests, the realm of monster transformation is to transform into human form. Once the monster successfully overcomes the tribulation, it can directly transform into human form and look the same as a human monk.
Looking at this scene, this green-winged king snake should be going through the catastrophe of transformation.
